description_en: Updates the safety lock of a service to minimize misoperations on the service
description_zh: 更新服务安全锁，可以一定程度上避免对服务的误操作
kebab_example: aliyun eas update-service-safety-lock --cluster-id cn-beijing --service-name foo --lock dangerous --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateServiceSafetyLock

parameters.description_en: The ID of the region where the service is deployed.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the service is deployed
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.description_en: The service name. For more information about how to query the service name, see [ListServices](~~412109~~).
parameters.description_zh: 服务名称。如何查看服务名称，请参见[ListServices ](~~412109~~)。
parameters.help_en: The service name. For more information about how to query the service name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务名称。如何查看服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.description_en:
The lock scope. Valid values:

*   all: locks all operations.
*   dangerous: locks dangerous operations such as delete and stop operations.
*   none: locks no operations.
parameters.description_zh:
安全锁级别。
- all：锁所有操作。
- dangerous：锁危险操作（例如：删除、停止）。
- none：不加锁。
